subject: NexBridge private marketplace offer — request for credit + commission carveout
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Deal Desk <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Legal <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Partner Ops <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 7 Jun 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: NexBridge private marketplace offer — request for credit + commission carveout

Hi Karthik / Marissa —

Quick heads-up: NexBridge (large analytics SaaS) wants to sign via AWS private offer. They are a strategic reference for Q3 and pushing to close this month. Key asks from their side (see attached term sheet + SOW):

- Marketplace listing as a private offer (AWS) with Redwood managed fulfillment.
- Upfront onboarding credit: $200,000 applied against the first 3 invoices.
- Reduce standard marketplace commission to 12% for the first 12 months (we normally do 20% gross rev-share with AWS).
- Net-60 payment terms for Redwood invoiced post-marketplace settlement.
- 12-month initial term with optional 12-month auto-renew.

Why the concession: NexBridge is bringing a sizable contracted spend (expected $1.2M ARR through the marketplace in year one) and will bundle our inference product into a broader stack in their sales channel. They want a lower apparent commission to justify the margin to their channel partners. AWS is willing to accept the listing but needs our internal signoff on the commission carveout and the credit.

Impact notes (initial):
- Revenue displacement risk if we reduce commission; however, expected net-new ARR is material and customer will provide a public case study.
- Upfront credit increases short-term cash pressure; finance needs the revenue recognition plan.
- Legal: standard marketplace T&Cs plus Redwood SOW clauses in attachment — they requested a small indemnity tweak (limitation of liability tied to their primary contract).

Ask: Exec approval for the following deviations from standard marketplace terms: 1) one-time onboarding credit up to $200k, 2) temporary commission reduction to 12% for 12 months, 3) Net-60 payment term. If approved, I will coordinate a DocuSign-ready package with AWS partner ops and NexBridge procurement (attached term sheet + SOW).

Attachments: NexBridge_SOW_v1.pdf, NexBridge_marketplace_term_sheet.xlsx, HubSpot-RDW-9874-note.txt

Thanks — I need an answer by EOD PT to keep momentum.

— Priyom
Priyom Das | Senior Account Executive, Marketplaces
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 7 Jun 2028 10:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NexBridge private marketplace offer — request for credit + commission carveout

Priyom —

Thanks for the summary and attachments. A few clarifying questions before we route to Marissa for exec sign-off:

1) Margin impact: can you confirm the modeled net contribution (post-credit, post-commission) for Y1 and Y2? I need an ARR/GM estimate to present.
2) AWS confirmation: do we have a written acceptance from AWS partner ops that they will list at our requested 12% rev-share and/or absorb any portion? I know AWS has limits on changing their marketplace split.
3) Legal redlines: Laura, please flag any deal-stoppers in the indemnity liability tweak — we need a short summary.
4) Finance: Jonas, if we grant Net-60, can finance support the cash flow profile given the $200k credit? If not, propose alternatives (escrow, staged credits).

If we can get clear answers on 1–4, I can include the numeric impact in the approval note for Marissa. Priyom, please paste the internal ARR/GM numbers inline if you have them.

Karthik
Director, Deal Desk

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, AWS Marketplace <marketplace-sales@amazon.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Jun 2028 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NexBridge private marketplace offer — request for credit + commission carveout

Thanks team — I reviewed the ask and the attachments. I am prepared to approve the exceptions on the following conditions:

1) Upfront credit capped at $200,000 and payable only against signed SOW milestones. Credits must be staged: $75k at contract signature, $75k at onboarding completion (30 days), $50k at first production invoice. No cash upfront.

2) Commission carveout to 12% for the first 12 months only; on month 13 revert to standard commission. This applies to gross marketplace bookings where Redwood is the listed seller. We will not agree to any permanent reduction.

3) Net-60 is approved only if Finance signs off on a receivable reserve. Jonas: please confirm feasibility and specify required reserve % and timing.

4) Legal approval required. Laura: if the indemnity tweak materially increases our exposure, we will not approve. Provide a redline with recommended language by EOD.

5) Customer commitments: NexBridge must commit to a joint case study and at least two co-marketing activities within 6 months and provide a named reference. This is mandatory for the concession.

6) AWS acknowledgement: marketplace-sales@amazon.com — confirm in writing that AWS accepts the 12% carveout for this private listing and that AWS will not apply a conflicting fee structure that undermines the math.

If all conditions are met I approve the package and authorize Karthik to finalize the internal approval ticket and generate the DocuSign flow. Priyom — update me once the conditions are satisfied.

Marissa Cole | VP, GTM
Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Morris <kate@nexbridge.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@nexbridge.com>, AWS Marketplace <marketplace-sales@amazon.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 7 Jun 2028 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: NexBridge private marketplace offer — next steps and conditions for approval

Kate / team —

Thanks for the productive discussion this morning. Per internal review, Redwood can approve the private offer exceptions requested, subject to the following conditions (these are firm):

- Onboarding credit: $200,000 total, staged as follows (no cash paid upfront): $75k at signature, $75k at onboarding completion (30d), $50k at first production invoice.
- Commission: 12% for months 1–12, then revert to standard commission (our standard marketplace split) on month 13.
- Payment: Net-60 accepted conditioned on Redwood Finance establishing a receivable reserve; Jonas will follow up with exact reserve requirements.
- Legal: final SOW must use Redwood's redline (Laura will send) — no expanded indemnity beyond what's in the SOW attachment.
- Marketing: NexBridge agrees to one published case study and two co-marketing activities within 6 months.

Next steps:
1) Kate — please confirm you accept the staging and marketing requirements and that NexBridge procurement will sign the DocuSign envelope.
2) AWS Marketplace — please confirm in writing that the private listing can be created with a 12% Redwood commission for months 1–12 and that there are no AWS-level fees that change the net economics.
3) Karthik/Marissa/Laura/Jonas — please add your formal approvals to the HubSpot deal record once AWS confirms.

I will prepare the DocuSign packet (SOW + private offer term sheet) once AWS confirms and Laura sends the final redline.

Thanks — Priyom
